_comment: The enum-to-clause map (ADR-1002). One key per BRANCHING field. Trace-lint reads this in two directions: a clause emitted but listed under no branch of the field that selected it is a trace FAIL; a clause listed under a branch that was NOT selected but present in the rendered bytes is a branch-mismatch FAIL. Six ordered leaks across payment_model are fixture-pinned, plus both gst_registered directions.
